sections.title: Ages of stone and metal (one box per age)
sections.intro: Each big box is an age. Small boxes: sites and finds.

facets.label: Sites
points: Bhimbetka (MP): rock shelters and paintings, Palaeolithic to Mesolithic
Attirampakkam (Tamil Nadu), Hunsgi (Karnataka), Kurnool caves (AP), Belan valley (UP)

facets.label: Life
points: No farming, no pottery, no metal

cards.hook: Tiny tools. First herding. Bagor and Adamgarh.

facets.label: Sites
points: Bagor (Rajasthan): earliest evidence of animal keeping
Langhnaj (Gujarat), Sarai Nahar Rai, Mahadaha (UP): animal-human burial

facets.label: Life
points: Hunting, fishing, food gathering; start of herding

facets.label: Tools
points: Microliths: tiny stone blades fixed in wood or bone

cards.hook: Farming starts. Mehrgarh oldest. Burzahom = pits and dogs.

facets.label: Earliest
points: Mehrgarh (Baluchistan, c. 7000 BCE): earliest farming in South Asia, wheat and barley, cattle
Ragi and horse gram in the south

facets.label: Sites: North
points: Burzahom (Kashmir): pit dwellings, burials with dogs, bone tools
Chirand (Bihar): bone tools, rice, wheat, barley

facets.label: Sites: South
points: Maski, Brahmagiri, Piklihal, Utnur, Hallur, Sangankallu (Karnataka, AP)
Utnur and Piklihal: ash mounds from burnt cattle dung

facets.label: Culture
points: Copper used with stone; still no iron
Painted pottery; villages in dry zones

facets.label: Sites
points: Inamgaon: house plans, child burials under floors
Daimabad: bronze rhino, buffalo, elephant, chariot

facets.label: Crops
points: Wheat, barley, jowar, bajra, rice, lentils

facets.label: Iron
points: Earliest iron at Hallur (Karnataka), about 1000 BCE
PGW culture (Painted Grey Ware): Hastinapur, Ahichchhatra, Atranjikhera, early iron
NBPW (Northern Black Polished Ware), from about 700 BCE: luxury ware of the cities

facets.label: Megaliths
points: Stone burials in the south: Adichanallur (TN), Brahmagiri
Types: cist, cairn circle, dolmen, menhir, urn burial

facets.label: Why it matters
points: Iron plough and axe cleared forests; cities of the Ganga plain grow

facets.label: Finds
points: Granaries in two rows of six

facets.label: Finds
points: Great Bath, Great Granary, Assembly hall

facets.label: Finds
points: Inkpot, lipstick, a dog chasing a cat footprint

facets.label: Where
points: Gujarat, near the Bhogavo; S R Rao, 1954

facets.label: Where
points: Rajasthan, on dry Ghaggar; A Ghosh, 1953

facets.label: Finds
points: Citadel and lower town both walled

facets.label: Where
points: Kutch, Gujarat; J P Joshi, then R S Bisht

facets.label: Finds
points: Three parts: citadel, middle town, lower town

cards.hook: Match the site to the limit.

facets.label: Haryana and Punjab
points: Ropar: man buried with a dog

cards.hook: Bronze Age. Planned towns. Undeciphered script.

facets.label: Town plan
points: Grid streets, burnt bricks, drains covered

facets.label: Religion
points: Mother goddess, Pashupati, pipal tree, bull, phallus worship

facets.label: Famous parts
points: Mandala 7: Dasarajna battle (Sudas vs ten kings)

facets.label: Gods
points: Indra: most hymns, about 250 (Purandara, fort breaker)

cards.key: Rivers of the Rig Veda: old name -> modern name
cards.hook: Learn the five Punjab names first.
Rig = hymns, Sama = songs, Yajur = rites, Atharva = spells.

facets.label: Sama Veda
points: Melodies; 1549 verses, mostly from the Rig Veda

facets.label: Yajur Veda
points: Formulas for sacrifice, prose and verse

facets.label: Helpers
points: Vedangas: Shiksha, Chhanda, Vyakarana, Nirukta, Kalpa, Jyotisha

facets.label: Politics
points: Bali: a gift, not a tax yet

facets.label: Economy
points: Cattle was wealth (gavishti = search for cows)
Nishka: gold ornament used in exchange

facets.label: Women
points: Could attend the sabha; Gargi, Lopamudra, Apala, Ghosha

facets.label: Politics
points: Bali becomes compulsory; Sabha and Samiti lose power

facets.label: People
points: Mahavira, 24th (Lion), born Kundagrama near Vaishali, about 540 BCE

facets.label: Teaching
points: Five vows: ahimsa, satya, asteya, aparigraha, brahmacharya (added by Mahavira)
Three Jewels: right faith, knowledge, conduct

cards.hook: Four great places: Lumbini, Bodh Gaya, Sarnath, Kushinagar.

facets.label: Life
points: Siddhartha Gautama, Lumbini, about 563 BCE; Sakya clan; father Suddhodana
Left home at 29, enlightenment at Bodh Gaya at 35, first sermon at Sarnath, died at Kushinagar at 80

facets.label: Teaching
points: Four Noble Truths, Eightfold Path, Middle Path
Anatta, anicca, karma; no soul, no creator

facets.label: Texts
points: Mahayana and Hinayana split after 4th council

sections.title: Dynasties on one line
sections.intro: Each row is a region. Bars that overlap in time ran together.

facets.label: Kings
points: Bimbisara (544 – 492 BCE): Rajagriha, Anga conquered, Buddha’s contemporary

facets.label: Line
points: Founded by Bimbisara; ended by Shishunaga

facets.label: Kings
points: Mahapadma Nanda: Ekarat (sole ruler), destroyer of Kshatriyas
Dhana Nanda: last; Alexander’s time, rich army

facets.label: Notes
points: First non-Kshatriya line; big army; canals and heavy taxes
Ended by Chandragupta Maurya, helped by Chanakya

facets.label: End
points: Brihadratha killed by Pushyamitra Shunga, 185 BCE

facets.label: Facts
points: Battle of the Hydaspes against Porus, 326 BCE

facets.label: Work
points: Took Anga; first to use paid officials

facets.label: Work
points: Beat Vajji confederacy using rathamusala and mahashilakantaka
Built a fort at Pataliputra village (Patali)

facets.label: Link
points: Killed his father Bimbisara; Kosala war with Prasenajit

facets.label: Wars
points: Defeated Seleucus Nicator, about 305 BCE: gained Aria, Arachosia, Gedrosia, Paropamisadae; gave 500 elephants

facets.label: Religion
points: Became a Jain, starved to death (sallekhana) at Shravanabelagola with Bhadrabahu

facets.label: Admin
points: Spies, big army; 30-member city board at Pataliputra

facets.label: Facts
points: Took the empire to the Deccan; Taxila revolts, Ashoka sent to settle

facets.label: Tenure
points: Called Devanampiya Piyadasi; name Ashoka in Maski and Gujjara

facets.label: War and change
points: Kalinga war, 261 BCE; remorse; turned to Buddhism (Upagupta)
Dhamma, not Buddhism; Dhamma Mahamattas (13th year)

facets.label: Edicts
points: 14 Major Rock Edicts; 7 Pillar Edicts; Minor Rock Edicts; separate Kalinga Edicts at Dhauli and Jaugada
Languages: Prakrit in Brahmi; Kharosthi at Shahbazgarhi, Mansehra; Greek and Aramaic in Afghanistan

facets.label: Buddhism
points: 3rd Council at Pataliputra, 250 BCE; Mahendra and Sanghamitra to Sri Lanka

facets.label: Symbols
points: Sarnath lion capital: national emblem; wheel on the flag

facets.label: City board
points: Pataliputra: 30 members, 6 boards of 5 (industry, foreigners, births and deaths, trade, goods, tax)

facets.label: Taxes and money
points: Bhaga: 1/6 of produce; Bali: religious tax

facets.label: Army
points: Six boards (infantry, cavalry, elephants, chariots, navy, transport)

facets.label: Who
points: Sudas (Bharata) vs ten tribes, with Vishwamitra / Vasishtha as priests

facets.label: Result
points: Sudas won; Bharata and Puru later joined to form the Kuru

cards.hook: Alexander’s last big battle in India.

facets.label: Where
points: Jhelum (Hydaspes); Ambhi of Taxila helped Alexander

facets.label: Result
points: Porus lost, but Alexander returned his kingdom; troops refused to cross the Beas

cards.hook: Border of India reaches the Hindu Kush.

facets.label: Result
points: Seleucus ceded Aria, Arachosia, Gedrosia and Paropamisadae; 500 elephants in return

facets.label: Result
points: About 1,00,000 killed and 1,50,000 deported (13th Rock Edict)
Ashoka gave up war; Dhamma Vijaya

sections.title: Dynasties on one line
sections.intro: Rows are regions. Bars that overlap ran at the same time. Click a bar to jump to its box.

facets.label: Marks
points: Bharhut stupa and Sanchi railings; Heliodorus pillar at Besnagar (Garuda, Vasudeva)

facets.label: Kings
points: Demetrius; Menander (Milinda), capital Sakala; Nagasena, Milindapanha

facets.label: Marks
points: First gold coins with names and portraits, bilingual coins

facets.label: Kings
points: Maues (first Shaka), Nahapana (Kshaharata), Rudradaman I (130 – 150 CE)

facets.label: Marks
points: Junagadh inscription of Rudradaman: first long Sanskrit inscription; Sudarshana lake repair

facets.label: Kings
points: Gondophernes: Takht-i-Bahi inscription; St Thomas story

facets.label: Kings
points: Kanishka (78 – 101 CE): capital Purushapura, Mathura; Saka era; 4th Council; Gandhara and Mathura art

facets.label: Marks
points: Silk route trade; Mahayana; Ashvaghosha, Nagarjuna, Charaka, Vasumitra

facets.label: Marks
points: Matronymic names; first land grants; Prakrit

facets.label: Marks
points: Vanji; port Muziris, Tondi; bow emblem

facets.label: Marks
points: Madurai; pearls, Korkai port; fish emblem

facets.label: Marks
points: Mihirakula: cruel; beaten by Yashodharman and Baladitya

facets.label: Work
points: Deeds year by year; canal of Nandaraja; Jain king
Raided Magadha, Rathikas, the Satavahana kingdom

facets.label: Work
points: Titles: Ekabrahmana, lord of three seas
Prasasti by his mother Gautami Balashri at Nasik

facets.label: Link
points: Son Vasishthiputra Pulumavi married Rudradaman’s daughter

facets.label: Wars
points: Dakshinapatha: twelve kings captured and freed, including Vishnugopa of Kanchi, Hastivarman of Vengi (AP), Mantaraja of Kurala
Forest kings, frontier states paid tribute

facets.label: Titles
points: Kaviraja, Parakramanka; played the veena on coins

facets.label: Other
points: King of Sri Lanka Meghavarna asked leave to build a monastery at Bodh Gaya

facets.label: Wars
points: Defeated Shaka Rudrasimha III of Malwa and Gujarat
Daughter Prabhavatigupta married Vakataka Rudrasena II

facets.label: Court
points: Navaratnas: Kalidasa, Amarasimha, Varahamihira, Dhanvantari, Vararuchi, Shanku, Ghatakarpara, Kshapanaka, Vetalabhatta

facets.label: Other
points: Ujjain second capital; Mehrauli iron pillar; silver coins

facets.label: Wars
points: Defeated Shashanka of Gauda (revenge for Rajyavardhana)
Lost to Pulakeshin II on the Narmada, 618–19

facets.label: Religion
points: Shaiva, then Mahayana Buddhism; Kannauj assembly and Prayag Maha-Moksha Parishad (every 5 years)

facets.label: Admin
points: Bhukti, Vishaya; taxes: bhaga, hiranya, bali; land grants (Madhuban, Banskhera plates)

facets.label: Wars
points: Beat Pallava Mahendravarman I; killed by Narasimhavarman I at Vatapi, 642

facets.label: Source
points: Aihole inscription by Ravikirti, 634 CE (Jain poet)

facets.label: Other
points: Persian embassy of Khusrau II; Xuanzang visited

facets.label: Date
points: 300 BCE – 300 CE; three Sangams at Madurai

facets.label: Society
points: Five regions (tinai): kurinji, mullai, marutam, neytal, palai
Taxes: kists paid in kind, irai

facets.label: Trade
points: Periplus of the Erythraean Sea (about 60 CE), Pliny: gold drain

facets.label: Others
points: Periplus (anonymous); Pliny Natural History; Ptolemy Geography

facets.label: Admin
points: Provinces: bhukti (uparika); districts: vishaya (vishayapati); village: gramika

facets.label: Art
points: Dashavatara temple Deogarh, Bhitargaon brick temple

facets.label: Result
points: Nahapana killed, coins restruck, Satavahana honour restored

facets.label: Why
points: Shaka power in Maharashtra and Gujarat

facets.label: Route
points: Through the forest kingdoms and the east coast

facets.label: Result
points: Captured, then freed: they paid tribute

facets.label: Result
points: Shaka line of Western Kshatrapas ended (about 395)

facets.label: Result
points: Huns held off about 455; later Toramana and Mihirakula broke through

facets.label: Result
points: Harsha stopped; Narmada became the border

facets.label: Result
points: Pulakeshin II killed; Vatapi taken; Pallava title Vatapikonda
